svg.text: Which series share their backtest errors decides how wide each series' interval is

text.tspan: Each window forecasts data the model
has not seen. Error per series, window
and step, scaled by the series' σ:
The errors of the series that share a
pool are put together, per horizon
step: the configurations below.
The pool's 10% / 90% errors for an
at the finite-sample conformal rank.
Applied to every future step of every
series of the pool, clipped at 0 for
non-negative data.
CQR
(models with native quantiles) pools the misses outside the model's own band the same way, and corrects the band: [lo − σ·q_lo, hi + σ·q_hi].
Small groups
(fewer than min_scores_per_group = 100 errors per step: 34 series at 3 windows) merge into one "other" pool.
No calibration: the model's own quantiles, as
written by run_forecast. Models without native
intervals have none (NULL).
Held out:
Off nominal both ways: too wide on intermittent
data (M5 SeasonalNaive 0.90 at 80%), too narrow
elsewhere (M4 AutoETS 0.885 at 95%).

svg.text: errors of all series, step h

text.tspan: One pool of all series, per horizon step.
Conformal: each series' tail quantiles lean
23% on its own errors, 77% on the pool's
(λ = W / (W + κ), W = 3 windows, κ = 10).
CQR: the pool's correction, no per-series part.
Held out:
0.94–0.97 at 95% on 8 of 11 datasets; under
only where the held-out horizon is harder than
the backtest (Electricity, Traffic).
One pool per class of volume × volatility:
A = top 80% of the total volume, B the next 15%,
C the last 5%; X / Y / Z = terciles of the
coefficient of variation (X the most stable).
Held out:
Helps intermittent demand (M5, Car Parts, Online
Retail): worst-decile gap −5 to −27 pts, WIS −1 to
−7%. Hurts rates, prices: Traffic −3 to −10 pts.
One pool per Syntetos-Boylan class, from the
average demand interval (ADI, threshold 1.32)
and the squared CV of non-zero demand (0.49).
Held out:
Close to the default: most series are "smooth",
so one class holds most of them. WIS −2 to −6%
on Online Retail.
One pool per value of columns of train_data
(several columns combine into one key): the
user's own groups, e.g. store × category on M5.
Held out:
Neutral on M5 (store × category) and Tourism
(purpose). EPF by market: −4 pts of coverage
(pools large enough only at 6 windows).

svg.text: one pool, each series' scale cᵢ

text.tspan: One pool; each series' scale is shrunk toward
the pool's instead of its tails:
cᵢ = (nᵢdᵢ + κ d_pool) / ((nᵢ + κ) d_pool),
dᵢ its mean absolute error; bounds ŷ + σᵢ cᵢ q.
Held out:
Under-covered M4 monthly (WindowAverage 0.71 /
0.85 at 80 / 95%): replaced as the default by the
per-series tails, kept as an option.
Decision:
one pool stays the default; ABC × XYZ is recommended for intermittent demand only, never for rates or prices.
